clips.title: The story
paras: At Ratchet, Monte Gazlowe keeps a neutral port open to traders from every side. He founded the town with the fortune he earned as the Horde’s chief engineer during the building of Durotar and Orgrimmar.

At Ratchet, Monte Gazlowe runs a port where rivals can trade under the Steamwheedle Cartel. He founded the town on the barren coast after earning a handsome payday for his engineering work with the new Horde. Horde, Alliance, and independent traders may barter there, so long as they keep their weapons sheathed and their purses heavy.

After the Third War, Warchief Thrall hired Monte Gazlowe as Durotar’s chief engineer to solve urgent problems for the new orc capital. Gazlowe took on the dangerous work of securing freshwater for Orgrimmar. His tunnels broke into underground kobold dens, but the wandering beastmaster Rexxar arrived in time to help blast the caverns shut. Gazlowe finished his assignments and remains a favored contractor and friend to Thrall. He has even sent his foreman, Rezlak, to keep helping with orc construction across Durotar.

Trade brings good earnings to Ratchet, but maritime rivals and thieves trouble Monte Gazlowe’s business. The Southsea Freebooters have camps along the nearby Merchant Coast, where they seize cargo bound for Ratchet and steal goods from raw ore to Gazlowe’s custom-ordered boots. To protect his profits, the port boss often hires passing sellswords of any allegiance to clear pirate camps, recover stolen shipments, and settle scores with troublemakers at the docks.
